mismatches.source_text: Then you should choose the {vocation} of a knight and become a valiant fighter with sword and shield. ...
mismatches.en_text: Knights are stalwart melee fighters, the toughest of all vocations. They can take more damage and carry more items than the other vocations, but they will deal less damage than paladins, druids or sorcerers. ...

mismatches.source_text: Knights are the toughest of all vocations. They can take more damage and carry more items than the other vocations, but they will deal less damage than paladins, druids or sorcerers. ...
mismatches.en_text: Knights can wield one- or two-handed swords, axes and clubs, and they can cast a few spells to draw a monster's attention to them. ...

mismatches.source_text: Knights can wield one- or two-handed swords, axes and clubs, and they can cast a few spells to draw a monster's attention to them. ...
mismatches.en_text: If you want to be a tough melee fighter who can resist much longer than anyone else, you should consider choosing the knight vocation.

mismatches.source_text: So tell me: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A VALIANT KNIGHT? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
mismatches.en_text: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A VALIANT KNIGHT? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!

mismatches.source_text: Then you should join the ranks of the paladins, noble hunters and rangers of the wild, who rely on the swiftness of movement and ranged attacks. ...
mismatches.en_text: Paladins are sturdy distance fighters. They are tougher than druids or sorcerers and can carry more items, but they are less tough than a knight. ...

mismatches.source_text: Paladins are jacks of all trades. They are tougher than the magically gifted and can carry more items than druids or sorcerers, but they can take not as much damage as a knight can. ...
mismatches.en_text: Paladins have the longest attack range, and can deal the most damage on a single target. ...

mismatches.source_text: Paladins deal more damage than knights but less than druids or sorcerers, and have the longest range in their distance attacks. ...
mismatches.en_text: They can also use holy magic to slay the unholy and undead in particular. ...

mismatches.source_text: They can also use holy magic to slay the unholy and undead in particular. ...
mismatches.en_text: If you like to keep a distance to your enemy, shooting while you outdistance him, you should consider choosing the paladin vocation.

mismatches.source_text: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A DARING PALADIN? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!
mismatches.en_text: So tell me: DO YOU WISH TO BECOME A DARING PALADIN? Answer with a proud {YES} if that is your choice!

mismatches.source_text: Then you should learn the ways of the druids, healers and powerful masters of natural magic. ...
mismatches.en_text: Druids are healers and powerful masters of ice and earth magic. They can also do a little energy, fire or death damage as well. ...

mismatches.source_text: Druids can heal their friends and allies, but they can also cast powerful ice and earth magic to kill their enemies. They can do a little energy, fire or death damage as well. ...
mismatches.en_text: Druids cannot take much damage or carry many items, but they deal more damage than paladins or knights, and can target several enemies. ...

mismatches.source_text: Druids cannot take much damage or carry many items, but they deal much more damage than paladins or knights. ...
mismatches.en_text: If you wish to be a healer and wielder of powerful natural magic, you should consider choosing the druid vocation.

mismatches.source_text: Then you should become a sorcerer, a mighty wielder of deathly energies and arcane fire. ...
mismatches.en_text: Sorcerers are powerful casters of death, energy and fire magic. They can do a little ice or earth damage as well. ...

mismatches.source_text: Sorcerers are powerful casters of magic. They use fire, energy and death magic to lay low their enemies. They can do a little ice or earth damage as well. ...
mismatches.en_text: Sorcerers cannot take much damage or carry many items, but they deal more damage than paladins or knights, and can target several enemies. ...

mismatches.source_text: Sorcerers cannot take much damage or carry many items, but they deal much more damage than paladins or knights. ...
mismatches.en_text: If you wish to be a caster of fire and energy, hurling death magic at your foes, you should consider choosing the sorcerer vocation.
